description: Plan events and tasks as Markdown files (frontmatter) and view them in a calendar and Gantt chart.
config.include: Glob of Markdown files to read.
config.template.body: Body of new files. `{{title}}` and `{{date}}` are replaced.
config.template.frontmatter: Extra frontmatter for new files, e.g. `{"tags": ["work"]}`.
config.properties: Frontmatter key names to read instead of the defaults, e.g. `{"end": "due"}`.
config.statuses: Status values in order. The first one is used for new items.
config.statuses.name: Value written in frontmatter.
config.statuses.label: Display name (optional).
config.statuses.progress: Progress shown in the Gantt chart (0-100).
config.eventColor: Color of items with type: event.
config.hideDone: Hide completed tasks in the calendar and Gantt chart.
config.language: Language of the Mark Planner screens and messages.
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language
